```{r}
dataset <- housepi::survey

enc_dict <- list(age = list(x = c(0, 10, 20, 40, 60), type = "bin"),
                 sex = list(x = c(1, 2), type = "cat"))
# UPDATE
enc_dict <- list(age = list(breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 40, 60)),
                 sex = list(levels = c(1, 2)))

# generate an instance of the chain binomial model
hhsampler <- housepi::HouseholdSampler$new(enc_dict)
```

```{r}
hhsampler$compute_household_marginals(dataset)

hhsampler$generate_households(1)
```
